points.description: States the reservoir characteristic relationships needed: storage (volume) vs elevation of the reservoir AND water surface elevation (head) vs outflow (discharge) relationship.
points.partial_credit: Half marks if only one of the two relationships is given.

points.description: States the inflow hydrograph AND the initial conditions (values of storage, inflow and outflow at t=0).
points.partial_credit: Half marks if only one of the inflow hydrograph or the initial values is given.

rubric.notes: Full marks for covering about three quarters of the model items in any wording: the storage–elevation and elevation–outflow relations, the inflow hydrograph, and initial S, I, Q. Give part marks for a partial or vague answer covering some of these items. Give nothing if none of these items is mentioned. Extra wrong remarks do not cost marks.
